title: Nuke Build System with GitHub origin as Source of Truth
body: ViceSharp shall use the Nuke build system for all build, test, package, and publish operations. The build definition is a C# project (`build/_build.csproj`) that defines targets as code. GitHub `origin` (`https://github.com/sharpninja/vice-sharp.git`) is the git source of truth. Azure DevOps is retired and is not used. Historical `azure-pipelines.ci.yml` and `azure-pipelines.release.yml` files may remain in the tree; they are not the live git or wiki authority.
